method: Recheck manifest/catalog/each selected JSON digest and source-body/header member identities; run scratch v4 grammar and enumerate all form/attribute/nesting gaps. Does not re-stream raw archives, render, reverse-check or install a body product. Prior independent full v5 capture validation is separate evidence.

first_reasons.reason: source_context_mismatch: Body source identity differs from header refid
unsupported_list_marker: Unordered subset supports unlabeled disc items or matching explicit hyphen fields
unsupported_nesting: Child does not have a declared browser-safe parent
unsupported_paragraph_label: Bounded source paragraph number required
unsupported_list_marker: Ordered item requires exact bounded source label and positive declared value
unsupported_paragraph_label: Visible paragraph label differs from its source number
unsupported_nesting: Nested anchors are invalid HTML
unsupported_context: Captured context attributes are outside the render grammar

counts_overlap: All-form/attribute/parent totals count distinct selected documents per gap and overlap; first reasons count one per rejected document. Neither is a passing product count.
